about: Viewer picture effects (stand-in for a game's own list; point web/vite.config.ts GAME_EFFECTS at yours).

effects.label: Shading
effects.name: Shading, ambient occlusion

cost.against: all Auto at the device level then in use

effects.how: three r186 GTAOPass on the composer's own depth (normals reconstructed from depth: no second scene render), Poisson denoise, blended before tone mapping
effects.viewerHow: three GTAOPass, radius 10% of the model's half-diagonal, scale 1.8, 16 samples, clipped to its bounds

viewerCost.ms: not separable from noise on an RTX 3090 shared with a Blender bake (frames 0.2-3.3 ms either way)

effects.label: Contact
effects.name: Contact, contact shadows

cost.against: all Auto at the device level then in use

effects.how: screen-space contact shadows: 12 depth samples per pixel marched toward the sun over at most 2.5 m, faded out by 160 m and by the sun's strength
effects.viewerHow: three example webgl_shadow_contact: depth from below, blurred twice, on a ground plane; redrawn only when the model changes

viewerCost.draws: +1 per frame (the shadow plane); +3 passes only when the model changes

effects.label: Shadows
effects.name: Shadows, sun shadows

cost.against: all Auto at the device level then in use

effects.how: renderer.shadowMap.enabled / autoUpdate, as the a design decision level sets them
effects.viewerHow: the directional light's shadow map (game: PCF, bias -0.0005, normalBias 0.06; viewer look: PCF soft, floor only)

viewerCost.draws: +1 per shadow-casting mesh (cab-near game look 6 vs 4; a 2170-mesh original would roughly double)

effects.label: Glow
effects.name: Glow, bloom of screens, lamps and signs

cost.against: all Auto at the device level then in use

effects.how: three r186 UnrealBloomPass on the linear HDR picture before tone mapping; threshold above 1 so lit facades do not glow, only emissive lamps, windows and signs
effects.viewerHow: three UnrealBloomPass with this entry's params (as the game), fed by a separate emissive-only render (emissive colour x intensity x map, everything else black); a part with a live surface program renders its program's emission there, never its baked fallback map (2026-10-13 18:42: the still frame bloomed over the live TV as a double image)

viewerCost.draws: +18 per frame on cab-near (4 -> 22), +20 on the road junction (6 -> 26): emissive render + blur mips

effects.label: Smoothing
effects.name: Smoothing, anti-aliasing

cost.against: all Auto at the device level then in use

effects.how: msaa: the canvas's own antialias (no composer) or a 4-sample composer target; off/msaa without a composer change the WebGL context, so they apply at the next start (badge ↻); smaa: three r186 SMAAPass after the output pass
effects.viewerHow: MSAA from the context; refine = 32 Halton-jittered frames averaged when the camera stops, then rendering stops (Materials/Clay views)

viewerCost.draws: msaa: 0; refine: 0 while moving, +3 per frame for 32 frames at rest, then 0
viewerCost.ms: refine: about 0.5 s of work after each stop

effects.label: Sharpness
effects.name: Sharpness, render resolution
effects.autoNote: scale of the device's pixel ratio capped at QUALITY.maxPixelRatio; level 0 uses 0.85 except in the map view (a design decision)

cost.against: all Auto at the device level then in use

viewerCost.ms: fill rate scales with the square: 2 = 4x the pixels of 1; not measured here

tiers.label: Standard
tiers.note: /mechanics/ at a design decision level 4 (full detail): sun shadows live, MSAA, pixel ratio min(devicePixelRatio, 2).

tiers.label: Low
tiers.note: ?quality=low (perf/ScenePolicy.js): never creates a sun shadow map; MSAA; same pixel ratio. The old step-down ladder (pixel ratio 1, shadow map 1024) is off since a design decision.
